contract_rules.transport: JSON over internal function calling or HTTP
contract_rules.read_tools: May retry once on timeout; must not mutate business state
contract_rules.write_tools: Require authenticated_user_id, case_id, trace_id, confirmation_token when user authorization is needed, expected_version and idempotency_key
contract_rules.llm_boundary: The LLM may select an allowed tool and fill validated arguments; it may not alter returned money, policy, permission or status fields
contract_rules.pii: Only masked identifiers and minimum necessary evidence metadata may enter the LLM context

tools.name: list_user_orders
tools.purpose: Return only orders the authenticated user may view, with masked summary fields.

tools.name: get_order_detail
tools.purpose: Read the authoritative order snapshot and version.

tools.name: get_policy_snapshot
tools.purpose: Return the policy shown at booking time, not the current website policy.

tools.name: list_after_sale_events
tools.purpose: Return append-only after-sale events for the confirmed order.

tools.name: calculate_refund_quote
tools.purpose: Deterministically calculate refund, fee, allocation and route from order and policy facts.
constraints: refund_amount + cancellation_fee must equal the refundable calculation base

tools.name: validate_action_permission
tools.purpose: Check identity, order state, risk level, policy version and action authorization.

tools.name: submit_cancellation
tools.purpose: Cancel an eligible order and create the corresponding refund record.

tools.name: get_action_result
tools.purpose: Resolve an unknown write result by idempotency key before retrying.

tools.name: get_refund_status
tools.purpose: Read refund and payment-channel status without translating initiated into received.

tools.name: get_payment_events
tools.purpose: Distinguish capture, refund, preauthorization hold, reversal and chargeback events.

tools.name: schedule_deadline_action
tools.purpose: Register a one-time action when an external SLA expires.

tools.name: create_payment_investigation
tools.purpose: Create a payment investigation only after SLA breach, failed status or unknown status.

tools.name: verify_fulfillment_issue
tools.purpose: Record and verify hotel no-room, refusal or price-increase signals.

tools.name: get_alternative_hotels
tools.purpose: Return mock alternative inventory for the same stay dates and area.

tools.name: get_guarantee_quote
tools.purpose: Calculate eligible refund or price-difference guarantee range; human confirmation may still be required.

tools.name: reserve_mock_alternative
tools.purpose: Place a temporary hold on mock alternative inventory; it does not create a real booking.

tools.name: create_human_handoff
tools.purpose: Create a specialist handoff with complete structured context.

tools.name: get_handoff_status
tools.purpose: Read human queue, assignment and response status.

tools.name: confirm_recovery_outcome
tools.purpose: Record whether urgent accommodation was restored and what remains unresolved.

tools.name: build_supplier_case_draft
tools.purpose: Build a structured supplier-negotiation draft for user review.

tools.name: create_supplier_case
tools.purpose: Submit a user-confirmed exception request to the mock supplier workflow.

tools.name: get_supplier_case
tools.purpose: Read supplier response, offers, validity and waiting party.

tools.name: accept_supplier_offer
tools.purpose: Accept a still-valid supplier offer after user confirmation and trigger its business action.

tools.name: submit_evidence_metadata
tools.purpose: Attach minimum necessary evidence metadata or a mock reference; raw sensitive content is excluded from LLM context.

tools.name: extract_evidence_fields
tools.purpose: Extract scenario-specific structured fields for user confirmation, not final authenticity judgment.

tools.name: create_exception_review
tools.purpose: Create a human review for illness, disaster or transport interruption.

tools.name: create_service_dispute_case
tools.purpose: Create a hotel service dispute with evidence and current-stay recovery needs.

tools.name: get_change_quote
tools.purpose: Compare allowed order changes, inventory, price difference and cancellation alternative.

tools.name: submit_order_change
tools.purpose: Apply a confirmed date or room-type change.

tools.name: create_finance_case
tools.purpose: Escalate duplicate charge, deposit, preauthorization or reconciliation anomalies.

tools.name: get_responsibility_chain
tools.purpose: Explain merchant of record, supplier chain, refund executor, currency and relevant timezones.

tools.name: get_group_order_breakdown
tools.purpose: Return rooms, guests, payer, authorization and invoice relationships for group orders.

tools.name: get_partial_cancel_quote
tools.purpose: Preview room-level refund, fee, discount allocation and invoice impact without executing.
